description: When no decorative handmade lines are specified, the exterior of the jacket shows no visible hand-stitching on its seams, edges, or lapels — the construction reads as entirely clean and machine-finished. This is the appropriate choice for formal business suits and any context where an unadorned, austere surface is preferred, allowing the cloth itself, the cut, and any pick stitching to carry the visual interest without the additional artisan texture of exposed pad stitches. The absence of visible hand lines does not imply lower construction quality — the jacket may still be fully hand-canvassed internally.
